info.title: customer-service-dataset
info.description: This dataset consists of a collection of question-answer pairs between customers and customer support agents regarding VNPT Money, a mobile money service offered by VNPT, a Vietnamese telecommunications company. The dataset encompasses various inquiries, covering various aspects of VNPT Money, including account setup, fees, promotion, and general product information.
